thread_text:
Maya Patel: Recruiting ops: several new interviewers onboards couldn't access the updated scorecard template from the panel invite this morning. Panels affected: 10210, 10211. Anyone else seeing this?
Samir Khan: I see 403s from the scorecard service for those panel_ids around 07:05. Looks like a token validation failure from the connector.
Lina Park: We rotated a signing key last night for the onboarding flow. Did we forget to publish the new public key to the ATS connector?
Evan Li: Confirmed: connector config still references the old key id. The rotation job published keys but the deploy that updates connector config failed on staging.
Maya Patel: Can we hotfix so interviewers can access scorecards before afternoon slots?
Samir Khan: Quick plan: 1) revert connector to use backup key (hotfix) 2) re-run onboarding key sync job with proper rollout checks 3) run a sanity backfill to ensure scorecards attached for panels 10210/10211. I'll push the revert to canary now.
Lina Park: I'll update the onboarding runbook so key rotations include a connector config check. Also adding a one-line note to interviewer guide explaining how to reach out if scorecard link is missing.
Evan Li: After canary looks good I'll trigger the backfill: `./tools/ats-import --panel 10210 --reconcile`. Posting results here when done.
RecruitBot: created ticket R-2026-1105: "Connector key rotation missed ATS config -> scorecard access 403s" assigned to Samir Khan due 2026-07-05
Samir Khan: Hotfix deployed to canary and monitoring. Will update when backfill completes.
Maya Patel: Thanks. Please paste backfill success count so recruiting ops can confirm the interviewers have access.
